summary: All assertions follow from the proved elementary estimates. The coordinate restriction on the union of the row-specific sets gives the simultaneous slab containment and, by coordinate independence, the claimed probability bound. The exact central-interval bound holds also for zero ranges and for ranges below L. The geometric specialization satisfies the tail hypothesis with the stated normalization and yields B=3 and C=2. The axis assertion and the restriction on classes with uniformly bounded trimmed support ratios are valid. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
